# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v2 c13 P38](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0038), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette is a tidy, unadorned, and pleasant young woman with a rosy face. She has a plump figure, which at one point lost seven pounds due to fretting over her exams.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P13](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0013), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Tranquil, steady, practical, and hardworking, Odette approaches life with composure and good sense. She possesses a gentle disposition and refrains from saying things that might hurt others' feelings. Though not particularly clever, her unshakeable calm serves her well. She is strict and pragmatic about discipline, believing firm order is necessary when managing a classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## History

During her childhood in Brierley, Odette attended school under Mr. Pidgeon and was part of a close group of friends that included Nell Harcourt, Isolde Pembroke, and Opal Pettigrew. She joined the local Story Club and wrote sensible, sensible stories, though reading them aloud made her feel foolish. After finishing her studies at Regent's Academy and passing her teacher's examinations, she accepted a position teaching at Stonebridge. She later served on the Brierley Village Improvement Society committee and briefly took over teaching at the Brierley school. Eventually, she departed for the West to teach on the prairies. After returning from the West, she married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Englishman from Winnipeg, in a lavish ceremony laden with diamonds and lace, and went on a European honeymoon before settling into a prosperous and happy married life.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c41 P5](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0005), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_
